description: §4.15 / §24.4 (S479) — a user declaration named `db` (`<db label:string="x"/> renders …`) is E-NAME-COLLIDES-RESERVED: `db` is the §4 built-in state block, whose body mode is chosen at the `<db>` opener before any declaration is bound, so a declaration of that name could never be used as one. Mirrors S478's `schema`.
provenance: ruling:user-voice-scrml.md S479 "⭐ RULED — the rest of S478 hand-off §3.B, PA recs adopted" item 15 (gap g-bootstrap-user-db-decl-takes-db-body-mode-s472)
rationale: §4.15: "registering a user component named `engine`, … `md` (S462, §67), `schema` (S478, §39), or `db` (S479, §4) is `E-NAME-COLLIDES-RESERVED` (the names are reserved structural-element identifiers; compared lowercase, §24.4)."
